title: When the Signal Sings
author: Zephyrine Oyelaran
blurb: Juniper Almeida, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
